card.name: Structural markers: dashes, list numbers, URLs
card.fires_on: Small structural pieces in web text: a dash after a dateline or byline, the number 1 starting a list or citation, or part of a URL. It does not depend on the topic.

modes.label: Dash after dateline
modes.description: A dash separating a source or date from the start of a news story.

modes.label: List or citation number 1
modes.description: The digit 1 opening a numbered list item or a bracketed reference.

modes.label: URL or reference piece
modes.description: A piece of a web address or the word at in a citation line.

card.plain: It fires on small formatting marks like dashes, list numbers and web address pieces, not on medical content.
